caption:
Tourists' Top 5 at Olive Young 🇰🇷 Picked by the data, not by hype. Not sponsored.

1. Torriden Dive-In Serum: the #1 brand with foreign shoppers at Olive Young (2024)
2. Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask: the overnight mask tourists turned into a must-buy
3. BEYOND Classic Hand Cream: hand care is the classic souvenir. Tourists make up 40% of Olive Young's in-store hand-care sales (Jan–Aug 2026)
4. VT Reedle Shot 100: the prickly feeling is by design. It's still skincare, not a procedure. Skip it on irritated skin and right after any skin procedure.
5. Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Cream: sun care was half of US shoppers' top 10 at Olive Young (2024)

📸 Screenshot the list near the end. The Korean names are on it, so you can show it to the staff.

Which one goes in your basket first? Drop the number 👇
